name: Junior Counselor Program
what_you_do: Help adult staff run nature camp: daily camp tasks and time with young campers, and help at events if you want. Full-day or half-day shifts.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 and up at Dunwoody Nature Center (15 and up at Island Ford). Be mature, reliable, flexible and energetic. You must attend a pre-camp orientation, in person the first time.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer position, no cost. You can ask for a letter documenting your hours.
duration: Asked to commit to a 5-day camp week, but you can work any days you are free. Full day 9:00 am to 4:00 pm or half day 9:00 am to 1:30 pm.
deadline_text: The page says applications opened in Spring 2026. No deadline is listed. If applications are closed, your info is kept until the next open period.
how_to_apply: Write to the Junior Counselor Coordinator. Ask how to join and what the steps are. The email is juniorcounselors@dunwoodynature.org.
notes: Phone 770-394-3322, info@dunwoodynature.org. The first email link on the page goes to a different address, so use the one in the FAQ (juniorcounselors@dunwoodynature.org). Camp dates are not listed on the page. Unpaid, so no work permit.
